input_text: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
recognized_text: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
scope: Real screen/controller recording and transcription, then real screen/controller synthesis and playback. The initial repeatable acoustic stimulus is synthesized before recording, played through the phone speaker and captured by the microphone. No transcript or phase is injected.

gif.crop: Actual app content; system chrome only is excluded.

limitations: One fixed synthesized sentence on one device. This is a UI and audio-path integration check, not a human speech recognition accuracy or latency benchmark.
